plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Builds features with TDD: a light mode (default) where the session plans and implements itself, and a full mode that runs specialist database/frontend/backend/devops engineers in parallel for well-specified multi-discipline work. User-approved plans, a shared context brief so agents don't re-explore the codebase, one reviewer that verifies and reviews each phase, phased delivery for large requests, and resumable paused runs.

plugins.name: test-team
plugins.description: A specialist testing team (unit/integration/e2e test engineers, a test-plan runner, and a bug reporter) that writes and runs tests and reports findings as structured bug reports, via the /test-team skill. The dev-team plugin reads open findings when planning, so they can be fixed in a follow-up run.
